map_note: County boards' own data runs ahead of the state's daily dashboard; where a county's figure is higher, it is used. Butler, Clermont, Franklin, Hamilton, Hancock, Morrow and Trumbull publish voter-level lists that include each voter's party, so their party splits are used too. Cuyahoga reports totals only, so the extra ballots count in totals but not party shares. Butler (as of 2026-10-22 03:01): mail returned 7,016 (state 5,582); early in person 18,417 (state 18,267); ballots sent 16,274 (state 15,877). Clermont (as of 2026-10-22 09:55): early in person 8,484 (state 8,357). Cuyahoga (as of 2026-10-21 17:07): early in person 20,302 (state 20,241). Franklin (as of 2026-10-22 00:12): early in person 41,217 (state 40,867); ballots sent 79,544 (state 78,667). Hamilton (as of 2026-10-21 19:44): early in person 30,691 (state 30,441). Hancock: mail returned 1,670 (state 1,636). Morrow (as of 2026-10-21 15:56): mail returned 790 (state 789). Trumbull (as of 2026-10-22 07:36): mail returned 6,938 (state 6,936).
